name: Colorado Threads
old_description: While we have made a lot of progress since 2014, we are still working to do better for you and the planet.
about:
Colorado Threads was founded in 2014 in Lakewood, Colorado, with a mission to keep plastic out of landfills and oceans. The company operates a boutique manufacturing facility and design studio in nearby Denver, where it produces its activewear line. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures activewear including yoga pants, tanks, hats, joggers, and accessories. Production is hand-crafted at the Denver facility using recycled polyester derived from plastic bottles; fabric waste is recycled into headbands and garments are upcycled. The brand distributes its products across 23 countries.

Colorado Threads serves the activewear, yoga apparel, and outdoor recreation markets. Its customer base includes wellness-focused consumers and outdoor enthusiasts. Concrete product examples include the Red Rocks concert yoga pants and the Grassroots x Colorado Threads Cosmic Wolf collaboration line.

The company differentiates itself through its Certified B Corporation status, which recognizes three impact business models: local economic impact through Denver-based production and regional sourcing within a 1,500-mile radius; sustainable practices such as BPA-free recycled materials and zero-waste manufacturing; and community giving that directs a portion of revenue to local nonprofits and youth programs.
